235  	  SUBROUTINE %(proc_prefix)sMP_BUILD_KINEMATIC_MATRIX(NLOOPLINE,P_LOOP,M2L,S_MAT) 
   236  C
   237  C       Helper function that compute the loop kinematic matrix with proper thresholds
   238  C       NLOOPLINE : Number of loop lines
   239  C       P_LOOP    : List of external momenta running in the loop, i.e. q_i in the denominator (l_i+q_i)**2-m_i**2
   240  C       M2L       : List of complex-valued masses running in the loop.
   241  C       S_MAT(N,N): Kinematic matrix output.
   242  C
   243  C    	ARGUMENTS
   244  C
   245  		INTEGER NLOOPLINE
   246      	%(real_mp_format)s P_LOOP(NLOOPLINE,0:3)
   247      	%(complex_mp_format)s M2L(NLOOPLINE)
   248      	%(complex_mp_format)s S_MAT(NLOOPLINE,NLOOPLINE)
   249  C    
   250  C    	GLOBAL VARIABLES
   251  C
   252       	include 'MadLoopParams.inc'
   253  C
   254  C    	LOCAL VARIABLES
   255  C
   256       	INTEGER I,J,K
   257       	%(complex_mp_format)s DIFFSQ
   258       	%(real_mp_format)s REF_NORMALIZATION
   259  
   260  C     	----------
   261  C     	BEGIN CODE
   262  C     	----------
   263  
   264       	do i=1,NLOOPLINE
   265         	  do j=1,NLOOPLINE
   266              
   267  		    if(i.eq.j)then
   268  	          s_mat(i,j)=-(M2L(i)+M2L(j))
   269  	        else
   270  	          DIFFSQ = (CMPLX(P_LOOP(i,0),0.0e0_16,KIND=16)-CMPLX(P_LOOP(j,0),0.0e0_16,KIND=16))**2
   271  	          do k=1,3
   272  	            DIFFSQ = DIFFSQ - (CMPLX(P_LOOP(i,k),0.0e0_16,KIND=16)-CMPLX(P_LOOP(j,k),0.0e0_16,KIND=16))**2
   273  	          enddo
   274  C             Default value of the kinematic matrix
   275  	          s_mat(i,j)=DIFFSQ-M2L(i)-M2L(j)
   276  C             And we now test various thresholds. Normally, at most one applies.
   277  	          IF(ABS(M2L(i)).NE.0.0e0_16)THEN
   278  	            IF(ABS((DIFFSQ-M2L(i))/M2L(i)).LT.OSThres)THEN
   279  	              s_mat(i,j)=-M2L(j)
   280   	            ENDIF
   281  	          ENDIF
   282  		      IF(ABS(M2L(j)).NE.0.0e0_16)THEN
   283  	            IF(ABS((DIFFSQ-M2L(j))/M2L(j)).LT.OSThres)THEN
   284  	              s_mat(i,j)=-M2L(i)
   285  	            ENDIF
   286  		      ENDIF
   287  C             Choose what seems the most appropriate way to compare
   288  C             massless onshellness.
   289                REF_NORMALIZATION=0.0e0_16
   290  C             Here, we chose to base the threshold only on the energy component
   291  	          do k=0,0
   292  		        REF_NORMALIZATION = REF_NORMALIZATION + ABS(P_LOOP(i,k)) + ABS(P_LOOP(J,k))
   293  		      ENDDO
   294  			  REF_NORMALIZATION = (REF_NORMALIZATION/2.0e0_16)**2
   295  	          IF(REF_NORMALIZATION.NE.0.0e0_16)THEN
   296                  IF(ABS(DIFFSQ/REF_NORMALIZATION).LT.OSThres)THEN
   297  	              s_mat(i,j)=-(M2L(i)+M2L(j))
   298  			    ENDIF
   299  	          ENDIF
   300              ENDIF
   301  
   302            ENDDO
   303          ENDDO
   304  
   305  	  END
